## One-Space High Pincer
This pincer is good if Black has a stone around <A:K16>. It's a severe pincer, reducing White's potential to make a base.

See also [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 23, Kim Junghyun 6p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H8Oehpm4Rho&t=140s).
